Subject: Initial ask — compliance on-ramps & MAP for evaluation

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked Redwood's latency profile and the cost controls, but legal/security want to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) that captures the compliance gates we need to close before a pilot and eventual production rollout. Specifically:

- SOC 2 scope and expiry / evidence timeline
- SIG/CAIQ self-assessment or vendor pack
- DPA redlines (security + data transfers)
- Data retention options (we need options for 30/90/730 day retention and an archival flow)

Can you send a proposed MAP template with owners and target dates? Our security lead (security@finapps.com) is on copy — she'll drop in the SOC 2 artifacts if available.

Also, if there are any non-negotiable requirements from Redwood on encryption/BYOK, please flag them up front.

Appreciate it — John

John — thanks, and glad the demo helped. Attaching a MAP template and a short SOC 2 summary that should answer your questions. High-level proposal below; happy to iterate:

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Week 0 (Dec 13): MAP agreed & owners named — Redwood (Hannah/Karthik), FinApps (John + security lead)
- Week 1–2 (Dec 14–27): Evidence exchange — SOC 2 summary + SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet; legal redlines to DPA
- Week 3 (Jan 4): Security review completed; retention policy chosen (30/90/730)
- Week 4 (Jan 11): Pilot approval gate (SOC 2 artifacts + SIG acceptance + DPA signed or DocuSign in flight)

Acceptance criteria for pilot gate (examples)
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 summary + evidence folder)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ with either in-line score or compensating controls documented
- DPA with agreed retention clause and breach notification timelines

Non-negotiables (quick callouts)
- Data-at-rest encryption required; BYOK (customer-managed keys) is available on Redwood Private and Dedicated; hosted API can be configured with KMS integration for enterprise tiers.
- Minimum retention options supported: 30 / 90 / 730 days; archival longer-term available via export.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, MAP_template.xlsx

Next steps: If that schedule looks reasonable, Karthik will follow up with the DPA redline path and Monica will add the acceptance checklist to the MAP. Can you confirm who your legal and security owners are so we can populate the sheet?

Thanks — quick update from security: attaching our initial SIG spreadsheet (FinApps_SIG_initial.xlsx). We can share a SOC 2 folder via Drive shortly — there is a Type II report from October 2026 but security wants to verify that the in-scope subservice providers match Redwood's processing flows.

On retention: our default ask is 90 days for drafts/logs and 730 days for permanent records; for the pilot we'd like the ability to test a 30-day short retention to validate deletion. Can Redwood support per-tenant retention policies and a documented deletion audit trail?

Also:
- BYOK: preferred but not mandatory for pilot if encryption at rest + KMS integration is documented.
- Can you confirm whether the hosted API pads or truncates user-supplied metadata fields on export? (security question — they want to ensure no PII remains in exports)

John / team — thanks for the SIG attachment and the SOC 2 pointer. I've sketched a short acceptance checklist and gated timeline so everyone's clear on the close path.

Pilot acceptance checklist (must be green to pass gate):
- SOC 2: Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II summary + evidence folder link; FinApps security reviews subservice mapping and confirms no critical gaps.
- SIG/CAIQ: Completed spreadsheet with either ticked answers or compensating controls documented for any gaps > medium.
- DPA: Redlines resolved or signature in DocuSign; retention clause accepted (we support per-tenant 30 / 90 / 730 day retention — deletion audit logs available for Dedicated/Private; hosted: audit logs available, deletion events recorded but archival flow differs).
- Crypto/BYOK: If FinApps needs BYOK we recommend Private or Dedicated; hosted KMS is available for enterprise with documented key rotation.

Proposed gated dates (draft)
- 2026-12-16: MAP owners confirmed; evidence links shared
- 2026-12-23: SOC 2 + SIG review complete (security comments consolidated)
- 2027-01-06: DPA signed / DocuSign in flight
- 2027-01-13: Pilot start (if all gates passed)
